item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1815,"end_unit":1816,"fact_summary":"The Prime Minister warned that destructive acts during political movements would not be tolerated; the archive also records allegations of irregular teacher recruitment and question-paper leaks involving officials.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.4","3B.2","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"Sheikh Hasina is identified as Prime Minister in the warning; the adjacent administrative irregularities are reported under parliamentary committee coverage, without a direct attribution to her personal direction.","limitations":["The archive provides headlines and metadata rather than full articles or findings.","The warning may concern public-order protection, but its proportionality and implementation are not established."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1824,"end_unit":1826,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that public pension funds were invested in treasury bonds, while parliamentary and media items described corruption concerns involving school expenditure and gambling-related money laundering.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","6B.2","6B.5","7B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The pension investment is attributed to government financial administration; the corruption reports concern public institutions and enforcement bodies, not a proven personal act by Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["No evidence is supplied on the investment decision's risk controls or returns.","The corruption items do not establish ministerial knowledge, authorization, or corrective action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1833,"end_unit":1834,"fact_summary":"The government considered the Ansar Battalion Bill 2023; parliamentary committee coverage records recommendations against granting Ansar arrest powers, while the Prime Minister publicly called for ending war and restoring mutual respect.","question_ids":["1B.8","2B.1","2B.4","2B.7","3B.5","3B.8","4B.4","8B.2","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The bill is a government/parliamentary initiative and the peace appeal is attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the committee recommendation is an institutional check rather than proof of her position.","limitations":["The supplied text does not show whether the recommendation was adopted or whether the peace appeal changed policy.","The foreign-war statement is not evidence about Bangladesh's use of force."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1849,"end_unit":1851,"fact_summary":"The archive reports irregularities in government assistance allocated to fishermen, widespread noncompliance with administered prices, and Chinese financing for a major construction project.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.5","5B.6","5B.8","5B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.7","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"These are reported implementation and policy outcomes under the national government led by Sheikh Hasina; the archive does not establish her personal involvement in the alleged irregularities.","limitations":["The snippets do not quantify the assistance diversion or identify responsible officials.","The financing item does not establish whether the debt was prudent or harmful."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1851,"end_unit":1853,"fact_summary":"During late-October political unrest, the archive reports arrests of 841 BNP and Jamaat activists, clashes involving police, and a subsequent statement that visa restrictions would be imposed in response to violence.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.6","2B.9","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The arrests and police response occurred under Sheikh Hasina's government; the archive does not prove that she ordered individual arrests or abuses.","limitations":["The snippets do not distinguish lawful arrests from arbitrary detention or establish casualty responsibility.","The visa-restriction statement is attributed to Donald Lu, not the Prime Minister."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1861,"end_unit":1863,"fact_summary":"The archive reports arrests and prosecutions of BNP leaders during political violence and a government narrative attributing renewed violence to BNP, alongside continued reports of arson, deaths, and transport destruction during strikes.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.6","2B.9","3B.1","3B.2","3B.3","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The attribution of violence to BNP is a government account; the arrests and prosecutions occurred under Sheikh Hasina's administration.","limitations":["The archive does not independently verify the competing accounts or the legality of the cases.","No direct quotation or underlying evidence is supplied for the government's attribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1873,"end_unit":1875,"fact_summary":"International actors called for dialogue and expressed concern about Bangladesh's political violence; Sheikh Hasina reportedly said she would hold dialogue when Trump and Biden did, while the government continued arrests during the unrest.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.6","2B.7","3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The dialogue remark is attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the international calls and arrests are reported by the archive.","limitations":["The statement's precise context and whether it was literal or rhetorical are unavailable.","The snippets do not establish whether the government rejected all dialogue or pursued other channels."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1883,"end_unit":1885,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that the Prime Minister thanked Jatiya Party MPs for being able to criticize the government, while parliamentary reporting documented substantial spending on Rohingya support and increased remittances in October.","question_ids":["2B.6","3B.7","4B.3","4B.7","5B.8","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.2","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The statement is attributed to Sheikh Hasina; Rohingya expenditure and remittance figures are reported through parliamentary coverage, without proving personal budget control.","limitations":["The reported appreciation of criticism does not establish broad protection for opposition or media.","No outcome evidence is supplied for the Rohingya spending."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1892,"end_unit":1894,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that Sheikh Hasina said journalists facing abuse should receive answers, while financial reporting documented banking and reserve risks and opposition criticism of the reserve situation.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","7B.1","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The statement about journalist abuse is attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the financial conditions are reported by Bangladesh Bank, opposition figures, and parliamentary coverage.","limitations":["The statement does not show whether perpetrators were investigated or disciplined.","The snippets do not establish whether the Prime Minister corrected or concealed the financial risks."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1907,"end_unit":1910,"fact_summary":"The archive reports nearly 8,000 arrests nationwide during political unrest, an International Crisis Group account alleging intensified repression before the election, and a separate report that the Awami League won two by-elections.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.8","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The arrests and election administration occurred under Sheikh Hasina's government; the repression assessment is attributed to the International Crisis Group.","limitations":["The archive does not provide arrest legality, judicial outcomes, or independent election verification.","The by-election wins do not by themselves establish electoral manipulation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1922,"end_unit":1925,"fact_summary":"The archive reports a finalized minimum wage of 12,500 taka for garment workers, continuing labor unrest, weak trade-union participation, and that election authorities suspended publication of two by-election result gazettes over irregularity allegations.","question_ids":["3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","5B.8","6B.3","6B.7","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The wage outcome and election administration occurred under the government led by Sheikh Hasina; the gazette suspension is attributed to the Election Commission.","limitations":["The snippets do not establish whether the wage was adequate relative to living costs or effectively enforced.","The irregularity allegations were not resolved in the supplied material."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1938,"end_unit":1940,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that Sheikh Hasina sought votes to complete unfinished development work, while international reporting and domestic analysis described worsening repression, declining foreign assistance for Rohingya refugees, and high food inflation.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.2","4B.3","5B.1","5B.9","6B.3","6B.6","8B.1","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The development appeal is attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the repression, aid, and inflation claims are attributed to named reports and analysts.","limitations":["The archive does not specify the development program, implementation record, or causal responsibility for inflation and aid decline.","The report headlines are insufficient to test the claims independently."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1943,"end_unit":1945,"fact_summary":"The archive reports overcrowding in prisons at twice capacity, allegations that political promotions increased before the vote, and international criticism concerning disappearances, extrajudicial killings, and human-rights accountability.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.10","4B.4","4B.5","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"These conditions and allegations arose under Sheikh Hasina's government; the archive does not establish her personal order or knowledge.","limitations":["No underlying reports, case files, or government responses are supplied.","The promotion allegation does not identify decision-makers or prove political manipulation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1954,"end_unit":1956,"fact_summary":"The government told the UN review that it would hold a free and fair election with public participation, while the archive also reports EU concerns about labor and human-rights challenges and high household dengue treatment costs.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.1","4B.3","4B.6","4B.8","5B.9","6B.2","6B.5","6B.6","7B.1","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The election and human-rights position is presented by the Bangladesh government; the EU statement and dengue-cost research are external assessments.","limitations":["The pledge is a commitment, not evidence of completed implementation.","The archive does not provide the government's response to the EU concerns or the health-cost distribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1969,"end_unit":1971,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that Sheikh Hasina warned of consequences for arson while opening Awami League nomination sales; it also records claims that sanctions rarely aid democracy and a report that five international organizations urged reassessment of garment-worker wages.","question_ids":["2B.3","3B.3","3B.8","4B.2","4B.3","4B.6","5B.8","6B.3","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The arson warning and nomination activity are attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the sanctions and wage items are attributed to other speakers or organizations.","limitations":["The warning's legal basis and implementation are not described.","The nomination-sale report does not establish whether public resources or coercion were used."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1977,"end_unit":1980,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that a Commonwealth delegation observed the election environment, that Jatiya Party figures questioned whether people could vote freely, and that a High Court stay affected an anti-corruption commission recommendation.","question_ids":["2B.6","3B.4","4B.1","4B.3","4B.4","4B.8","7B.6","7B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The election environment was administered by institutions under Sheikh Hasina's government; the court stay is a judicial action, not a personal decision by her.","limitations":["The material does not report the delegation's conclusions or the substance of the stayed recommendation.","Opposition concerns are not independently verified in the supplied snippets."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1988,"end_unit":1990,"fact_summary":"The archive reports alleged recruitment corruption at Chattogram City Corporation, a case in which a deceased or disappeared person was reportedly sentenced, and improvements in Bangladesh's anti-money-laundering and counter-terror-financing framework.","question_ids":["1B.6","2B.9","3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","4B.5","5B.5","7B.2","7B.7","7B.9","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The institutional improvements and reported abuses occurred during Sheikh Hasina's administration; no personal direction is established.","limitations":["The snippets do not identify the responsible officials or final accountability.","The anti-money-laundering improvement is not quantified or linked to a specific reform enacted by the Prime Minister."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1994,"end_unit":1996,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that child development centres were in crisis, that Bangladesh's usable reserves fell below 16 billion dollars, and that the government started fertilizer production at the Ghorashal-Palash plant.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.6","5B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The plant opening and national economic conditions occurred under Sheikh Hasina's government; the child-centre report concerns public administration.","limitations":["The archive does not provide project costs, production performance, or the Prime Minister's role beyond the opening.","The reserve decline may reflect external shocks and does not alone establish policy failure."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2007,"end_unit":2009,"fact_summary":"The archive reports a new import-export control law after 74 years, alleged political cases involving dead and disappeared persons, and a continuing decline in trade-union strength.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","5B.4","5B.7","6B.7","7B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The law and administrative conditions arose under Sheikh Hasina's government; the political-case allegation is reported by the media and not personally attributed to her.","limitations":["The archive does not provide the law's text, implementation, or effects.","The political-case item is an allegation without case-level evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2011,"end_unit":2013,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that an alleged corruption case involved a city-corporation teacher recruitment process, that an Awami League nomination candidate list was issued, and that Sheikh Hasina told aspirants that any leader could run as an independent candidate.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.5","5B.5","7B.5","7B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The nomination guidance is attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the recruitment corruption report concerns a local institution and does not establish her involvement.","limitations":["The statement about independent candidates does not establish whether the election was genuinely competitive.","No evidence is supplied on the outcome of the recruitment investigation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2026,"end_unit":2028,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that a labor-law amendment was deferred to the next parliament, that a High Court order returned some candidates' eligibility, and that government officials were instructed to apply a land-use master plan nationwide.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.1","4B.4","4B.8","5B.4","5B.6","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The labor-law and land-planning items concern the government led by Sheikh Hasina; the candidate decision is attributed to the High Court.","limitations":["The archive does not explain why the labor amendment was deferred or whether the master plan was implemented.","The court ruling cannot be attributed to the Prime Minister."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2034,"end_unit":2036,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that Bangladesh's embassy warned the government about possible sanctions related to labor law, that election campaigning included allegations of rule violations, and that the government faced pressure to reduce fossil-fuel use.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.9","2B.6","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","5B.4","5B.7","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The embassy warning and national policies occurred under Sheikh Hasina's government; the election violations are reported by the Election Commission and media.","limitations":["The snippets do not state whether sanctions occurred or whether labor-law reforms followed.","The fossil-fuel item records external pressure, not a completed policy response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2045,"end_unit":2047,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that the Election Commission began transferring UNOs and OCs pursuant to its instructions, that international observers were invited, and that UN officials again urged an inclusive election.","question_ids":["2B.6","4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","4B.8","8B.2","8B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The administrative transfers were carried out by government bodies under Sheikh Hasina; the observer invitation and inclusion appeal are attributed to the Election Commission and UN.","limitations":["The material does not show whether transfers improved neutrality or were politically motivated.","The invitation and appeal are procedural commitments, not proof of an inclusive result."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2067,"end_unit":2070,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that 57% of independent candidates were excluded during election scrutiny, that approved development projects encountered early problems, and that Bangladesh was cited as an example of disaster management.","question_ids":["3B.9","4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","5B.6","5B.7","6B.6","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The election scrutiny and development implementation occurred under institutions in Sheikh Hasina's government; the disaster-management assessment is attributed to UNDRR.","limitations":["The archive does not state why candidates were excluded or whether appeals remedied errors.","The disaster-management recognition does not identify the Prime Minister's specific contribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2075,"end_unit":2077,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that Bangladesh faced severe dollar and liquidity shortages obstructing fertilizer imports, while Sheikh Hasina described Saudi Arabia as a consistent partner and the government received an IMF loan tranche proposal.","question_ids":["2B.8","5B.3","5B.9","6B.6","8B.2","8B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The external-partnership statement is attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the liquidity and IMF items concern government economic management.","limitations":["The snippets do not show the conditions, use, or effects of the IMF financing.","The economic pressures may reflect external conditions as well as domestic policy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2086,"end_unit":2088,"fact_summary":"The archive reports Bangladesh's UN position supporting Palestine, analysis describing governance weaknesses and foreign pressure, and that Sheikh Hasina received an Asia Climate Mobility Champion Leader award.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.4","1B.9","2B.1","2B.7","5B.7","8B.1","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The Palestine position and award are associated with the Prime Minister or Bangladesh government; the governance critique is an external institutional assessment.","limitations":["The award and diplomatic position do not establish measurable domestic climate or risk outcomes.","The governance analysis is summarized only by a headline."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2094,"end_unit":2096,"fact_summary":"The archive reports allegations of bribery connected to teacher appointments, that only 25% of doctors were staffing a national cancer hospital, and that diplomats pledged support for human-rights defenders.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.4","3B.7","4B.5","5B.2","5B.5","6B.2","6B.4","6B.5","7B.9","8B.4","8B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The reported staffing and appointment conditions existed under Sheikh Hasina's government; the bribery allegation concerns a state minister and officials, but does not prove the Prime Minister's personal involvement.","limitations":["The archive does not report investigation outcomes or corrective action.","The doctors figure lacks the hospital's required staffing baseline."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2115,"end_unit":2118,"fact_summary":"The archive reports continued UN contact over fundamental and voting rights, a High Court petition concerning a BNP politician's travel restriction, and government security measures against arson and attacks during the election period.","question_ids":["2B.6","3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.4","4B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The government's security response occurred under Sheikh Hasina; UN contacts and High Court proceedings are independent institutional actions.","limitations":["The snippets do not establish whether restrictions were lawful or politically motivated.","The security measures may have addressed genuine violence, but their proportionality is not shown."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2122,"end_unit":2124,"fact_summary":"The archive records Sheikh Hasina's call to the public to oppose arsonists and killers, a cabinet decision approving electricity and procurement proposals, and official Victory Day statements emphasizing national progress.","question_ids":["2B.4","3B.2","3B.9","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The public call is attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the procurement and electricity decisions are reported as cabinet actions under her government.","limitations":["The call uses strong security language and does not specify safeguards against wrongful targeting.","The archive does not provide procurement details, budget execution, or project outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2128,"end_unit":2130,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that the government monitored the economic effects of strikes and blockades, that financial institutions faced capital shortages, and that more people were leaving the country for employment.","question_ids":["3B.9","5B.3","5B.9","6B.6","6B.10","8B.7","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"Monitoring was attributed to the Prime Minister's Office; banking and migration conditions were reported by parliamentary and media sources.","limitations":["Monitoring does not demonstrate effective correction or relief.","The snippets do not identify the causes of capital shortages or whether migration was beneficial or distress-driven."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2133,"end_unit":2135,"fact_summary":"The archive reports a rise in net reserves to 20.41 billion dollars, a planned military deployment for election security, and uncertainty from the Chief Election Commissioner about whether the election would be accepted.","question_ids":["2B.8","3B.9","4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","4B.8","5B.3","8B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The reserve figure is reported by Bangladesh Bank; election deployment and uncertainty are attributed to the Election Commission and Chief Election Commissioner, under the government led by Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["The reserve improvement is a short-term indicator and does not establish durable macroeconomic recovery.","Military deployment does not by itself show coercion or improper election interference."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2144,"end_unit":2147,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that Sheikh Hasina began election campaigning, that the Awami League published a Smart Bangladesh manifesto, and that the Asian Development Bank lowered its FY24 growth forecast because of economic slowdown.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The campaign and manifesto are attributed to Sheikh Hasina and the Awami League; the growth forecast is attributed to ADB.","limitations":["The supplied material does not include the manifesto's detailed commitments or implementation timetable.","The forecast reflects expected conditions, not a final period outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2148,"end_unit":2152,"fact_summary":"The archive reports persistent inflation, high air pollution, allegations of election-code violations, concerns about candidate attacks, and government approval of major development projects over the preceding five years.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","6B.10","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The projects were approved by the government led by Sheikh Hasina; election violations and candidate attacks are reported by the Election Commission and media.","limitations":["The project total does not establish completion, quality, distribution, or value for money.","The archive does not identify the Prime Minister's response to the reported election violations or attacks."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied source is a parliamentary e-clipping archive consisting mainly of headlines, tags, dates, and short metadata rather than complete article text.","Many items concern government institutions or political actors without proving Sheikh Hasina's personal knowledge, intent, or direction.","The archive spans late 2023 and includes some events outside a strict calendar-year endpoint context; all cited items are treated as 2023-period evidence.","No supplied item materially concerns Bangladesh's possession or management of nuclear weapons, so 1B evidence is limited to broader de-escalation, catastrophic-risk, and dual-use governance analogies."]}
